reason: Every reachable startup primary symset outcome through configuration-error dismissal, the first map, and #optionsfull is source-reviewed and freshly matched; rogue and interactive selection remain explicitly excluded.

boundary.startingEvent: Startup parses a non-negated OPTIONS=symset:<value> statement.
boundary.endingEvent: Configuration errors are dismissed and the first map is rendered, or a valid selected set renders that map and appears in #optionsfull.
boundary.validInputs: Empty values, the 14 bundled primary set names, source default aliases, unknown primary names, repeated selections, and SYMBOLS overrides in either source-permitted order.
boundary.observables: Configuration-error text and raw wait, selection cleanup, symbol metadata and byte/UTF-8 tables, option ordering, redraw flags, complete screens and attributes, cursors, persisted startup state, and unchanged PRNG order.
boundary.exclusions: roguesymset, interactive handler_symset(), runtime symbol-file mutation or removal, and display behavior after the first rendered map/#optionsfull boundary.

candidateListMethod.upstreamEntryPoints: options.c optfn_symset(), files.c read_sym_file(), symbols.c clear_symsetentry()/switch_symbols(), and jsmain.js startup installation.
candidateListMethod.dispatchTablesAndCatalogs: The generated optlist.h row fixes parser eligibility; dat/symbols and scripts/generate-symbol-data.mjs define the exhaustive 14-set bundled universe.
candidateListMethod.reachableHelpers: Traced every optfn_symset request arm, read_sym_file success/failure/default branches, selected-set parsing, cleanup, switch_symbols(), ordered SYMBOLS overrides, menu value reporting, and first map consumption.
candidateListMethod.javascriptCrossCheck: Searched js/options.js, js/symbols.js, js/jsmain.js, generated symbol data, parser/menu/display tests, and unsupported/error paths for symset selection and delayed exceptions.
candidateListMethod.remainingLimits: The scorer's pinned symbols data makes missing files and malformed bundled sets unreachable; rogue and interactive selection are explicitly outside this boundary.

entries.evidence: options.c optfn_symset(); files.c read_sym_file(); symbols.c clear_symsetentry(); focused parser and display-symbol tests; scripts/run-startup-symset.mjs strictly matched seven fresh C segments through the raw wait, first map, and #optionsfull (17,262 PRNG calls, 89 screens and cursors).

sourceReview: The completed slice covers every optfn_symset do_set and read_sym_file outcome reachable with pinned symbols data through clear_symsetentry(), switch_symbols(), ordered overrides, the configuration-error wait, first map rendering, and #optionsfull. Seven fresh C/JavaScript cases pinned invalid-only startup, invalid-before/after-valid ordering, both SYMBOLS override orders, one bundled set, and a default alias. Rogue and interactive paths remain explicitly later.
